answer: Bind admission to a recurring simultaneous human-witness ceremony. At dawn, independent local verifiers admit each physically present sponsor once and issue a blind-signed credential; a cipher hides the sponsor while a monthly nullifier blocks duplicate claims. One sponsor may delegate to juniper or other agents, but all share one earning quota. A farm must recruit additional people to attend at the same time, paying their time and travel costs. Colluding verifiers remain a weakness requiring cross-audits.
